name: 资源池模板
data:
[core]
mass: 9000
name: extractorTemplate
price: 700
maxHp: 800
techLevel: 1
buildSpeed: 0.0010

#单位标题
displayText:示范资源提取器模板

#单位描述
displayDescription:可以生产资金的资源提前器，只能在资源池上面建造。请参考ini里面的注释和结合代码表使用。

#生产资金
generation_resources: credits=8

#footprint used for collisions with units (left, up, right, down)
footprint: 0,0,0,0

#used for placement, and placement of other buildings
constructionFootprint: 0,0,0,0

buildingSelectionOffset:4

radius: 18
displayRadius:20

isBuilding: true

#只能在资源池上面使用 为false就随便哪里建就可以了
placeOnlyOnResPool: true

#死亡的残骸数量
numBitsOnDeath: 16

#隐藏烧焦标记
hideScorchMark: true

[animation_idle]
onActions : idle
body_0s: {frame:0}
body_0.8s: {frame:3}
body_1.0s: {frame:3}

pingPong:true

[graphics]
total_frames: 4
image:        CORE:/extractor/extractor.png
image_back:   CORE:/extractor/extractor_back.png
image_back_always_use_full_image: true

[attack]
canAttack: false
canAttackFlyingUnits: false
canAttackLandUnits:   false
canAttackUnderwaterUnits: false
maxAttackRange: 0

[movement]
movementType: NONE
moveSpeed: 0
moveAccelerationSpeed: 0.01
moveDecelerationSpeed: 0.01

maxTurnSpeed: 0
turnAcceleration: 0.1

[ai]
#ai adds extra rules for placeOnlyOnResPool type units
#AI对建造资源池的单位优先级总是最高
buildPriority: 0.4

recommendedInEachBasePriorityIfUnmet:0.55
recommendedInEachBaseNum: 2

noneInBaseExtraPriority: 0.43

#noneGlobalExtraPriority: 0.3

maxEachBase: 99
